description: Test cases for an update log (changelog.json, and the OS's release-notes.json in the same format).
phoenix-default-apps tools/lib/changelog.mjs and webos-phoenix's catalog server both run them.
Each case: changelog (the parsed document), version (when given: the version its first entry must be),
error (null: valid; else the first problem's message, exactly). A validator lists the problems in the
order of its checks (tools/lib/changelog.mjs says the order), so the first is the same everywhere.
Lengths are in Unicode code points. Regular expressions are ASCII (\w, \b, \d) as JavaScript's and
